decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system builds on little of the firm's existing application-specific lighting knowledge and lacks strong early market signals, so the firm cannot easily assimilate feedback to improve it.
The spring-balanced desk lamp draws on mechanical design outside the firm's lighting and controls knowledge, limiting its ability to learn from early results and improve the product.
The general interior luminaire directly builds on the firm's core lighting and controls knowledge, enabling strong absorptive capacity and promising learning from early results.
The pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics leverages the firm's established optical and architectural lighting expertise, so it can interpret market feedback and improve the product.
The marine HMI searchlight is far from the firm's LED and building-lighting knowledge, and its early lack of promotion suggests weak ability to assimilate feedback for improvement.
The marine searchlight requires specialised marine knowledge the firm lacks, and its limited website presence gives little evidence that the firm can learn and improve it.
